body: Owner request 2026-10-17: support the latest OpenSpec (1.14.3) and Spec Kit (1.2.1) and use them in the build process; owner chose 'Product + CI'. Records decision 0540 (owner demand replaces the verified-absence-frontier three-pilot trigger; Corvint stays witness not harness; upstream tools stay out of the binary; own spec process unchanged; corrects the stale 'Spec Kit has only prompt templates' claim) and docs/specs/spec-toolchain-adapters-v0.md (STA-V0-001..013) with four implementation lanes.
title: Spec Kit/OpenSpec adapters: decision 0540 and STA-V0 spec
